witness_description: R=F_2, S=F_2 x F_2, phi(a)=(a,a), and V=R; multiplying phi(1)=(1,1) by (1,0) in S gives (1,0) not in phi(V).
refutation_explanation: Here ker phi={0}, so V contains ker phi, but phi(V)={(0,0),(1,1)} is not closed under multiplication by arbitrary elements of S and therefore is not an ideal of S.
search_space: All 16 functions from the two-element ring F_2 to the four-element ring F_2 x F_2, in lexicographic table order, paired with all 4 subsets V of F_2, checking the unital ring-homomorphism, ideal, kernel-containment, and codomain-ideal conditions exactly.
